name: My Tho
provinceNote: Since 2025, five wards of Đồng Tháp: Mỹ Tho, Đạo Thạnh, Mỹ Phong, Thới Sơn, and Trung An. The government directory prints 23 đường 30/4, phường Mỹ Tho.
dotReason: Worth a night when the Tiền is the trip
summary: Sleep on đường 30 Tháng 4 when the night is the Tiền: the embankment, the boats, and vườn hoa Lạc Hồng. Give the morning to hủ tiếu and Chùa Vĩnh Tràng, and leave the pier at 01 Hoàng Sa if the orchards are the plan. A same-day return to Ho Chi Minh City is 70 km and about 1 hour, or 66 km and 1.7 hours, so the boat has to be the morning. Ben Tre is the usual river day.
fee: Pagoda and museum gates are free on the portal. The cart is 40,000 or 30,000 VND. Other fares are check on arrival.
getThere: 70 km and about 1 hour, or 66 km and 1.7 hours, from Ho Chi Minh City. No passenger train.
seoTitle: My Tho guide — the Tien embankment and Vinh Trang
seoDescription: Stay a night on the Tien if the river is the trip. From Ho Chi Minh City the road is 70 km and about 1 hour, or 66 km and 1.7 hours. There is no passenger train.
intro: You are on the north bank of the Tiền, on the embankment along đường 30 Tháng 4. Boats sit on the water, the walk runs under the trees, and vườn hoa Lạc Hồng is the town pin at Trưng Trắc. Stay the night if that river is the trip. A same-day return to Ho Chi Minh City is the provincial figure of 70 km and about 1 hour on the Trung Lương expressway, or the ticket-page figure of 66 km and 1.7 hours. The return on that ticket page is 67 km and 1.7 hours. The boat has to be the morning, not the hour you arrive.

The four islets are not one island. Lân is cù lao Thới Sơn, in phường Thới Sơn, 6 km from the city on the rural-tourism page. Phụng is Tân Thạch, on the Ben Tre bank. Cầu Rạch Miễu carries National Route 60. Quân đội Nhân dân prints the project as 8,331 m and the bridge as 2,878 m. A construction-library page prints the main bridge as 2,868 m and the same 8,331 m overall. Minutes from the pier are check on arrival. The usual river day is Ben Tre, with Cái Bè, Rạch Gầm – Xoài Mút, Tân Thành, and Gò Công.

Chùa Vĩnh Tràng, on Nguyễn Trung Trực in phường Mỹ Phong, is the morning. The tourism portal prints 120 minutes, a free gate, and hours from 06:00 to 23:00. The pier is 1.96 km away, at số 01 Hoàng Sa, and the boat does not leave from the pagoda. The electric cart at that pier runs 07:00–22:00. Route 1 is 40,000 VND a guest. Route 2 is 30,000 VND. One portal page, no second tariff. Confirm the price at the pier. Bửu Lâm, Quan Đế, and Bảo tàng Tiền Giang are free on the same portal and have no licensed photograph here, so they are not cards.

The Thủ Khoa Huân statue stands in the garden where Báo Xây dựng places the old Sài Gòn–Mỹ Tho station. The rails stopped in 1958. There is no passenger train, and the planned Ho Chi Minh City–Cần Thơ line does not name a Mỹ Tho station. In 2025 the old city became five wards of Đồng Tháp. The national place page gives the old city 81.54 km² and 204 thousand people in September 2009.
gettingAround: From Ho Chi Minh City the two published road pairs do not match. The provincial roads page says 70 km and about 1 hour on the Ho Chi Minh City–Trung Lương expressway, by bus. A ticket page says 66 km and 1.7 hours toward Mỹ Tho, and 67 km and 1.7 hours toward Sài Gòn. Fares are check on arrival. No airport sits in the Mỹ Tho wards on the pages opened. Travelers who fly use Tân Sơn Nhất and then that road. Minutes from the terminal are check on arrival.

There is no passenger train. Tuổi Trẻ, 10 Oct 2025, says the Sài Gòn–Mỹ Tho railway ran from 1885 and stopped in 1958, about 70 km. The same article describes a Ho Chi Minh City–Cần Thơ line still in pre-feasibility, 175.2 km, with no Mỹ Tho station named. The old station site is vườn hoa Lạc Hồng, on đường 30/4 and đường Trưng Trắc.

The intercity bus station is on đường Ấp Bắc, on the provincial roads page. A street number and a ward were not in that paragraph. Check on arrival. The base itself is a walk along đường 30 Tháng 4 and đường dọc kè sông Tiền.

The electric cart parks at Cảng du thuyền Mỹ Tho, số 01 Hoàng Sa, phường Mỹ Tho. Two loops, each 7,000 m and 20–30 minutes, 07:00–22:00 every day. Route 1 is 40,000 VND a guest and passes the pier, Cầu Quay, Nhà Bạch Công Tử on Đinh Bộ Lĩnh, Chùa Vĩnh Tràng, the museum, and Vincom Plaza Mỹ Tho on Hùng Vương. Route 2 is 30,000 VND. The phone on the page is 0273 3.636.868. One source. Confirm the price at the pier. A boat fare from the pier, and motorbike and taxi fares, are check on arrival. Vincom is a named mall stop. No licensed photograph of the mall was filed, so it is not a card. Nhà Bạch Công Tử is a named stop on Đinh Bộ Lĩnh. What is inside was not described.

stayAreas.name: Đường 30 Tháng 4
stayAreas.summary: A river room in phường Mỹ Tho, facing the Tiền and vườn hoa Lạc Hồng. On Thới Sơn the rural-tourism page describes garden stays with thatch, wood, and a wharf. Named lodges are not picks.

eat: Hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho is the bowl, at breakfast, lunch, or supper. Dry, the strands are tossed with pork crackling, fried shallot, and soy, then topped with cooked minced pork. With broth, the ward page adds sliced pork, liver, intestines, shrimp, squid, and quail egg. The national page says the local way uses fresh bean sprouts, lime, chili, and soy, and that the bowl is not eaten with lettuce, vinegar, and a herb plate. A stall price is check on arrival.

The pier food court on 30 Tháng 4 is the late hour that was printed. A 5 Jan 2019 provincial article puts it inside the tourist-boat pier, 3,000 m², from 18:30 to 02:00. A travel page puts a night market at số 8 đường 30/4, from 18:00, busiest 19:00–22:00. The two clocks do not match. Elephant-ear fish, ginger honey tea, and coconut candy are named on Thới Sơn and are not pictured. Bánh tét and the night-court sweets have no serving note and no photograph.
interestsBody: Hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho is the photographed bowl. The islet plates and the night-court sweets are named and not pictured.
Vĩnh Tràng is the pagoda with a photograph. Bửu Lâm and Quan Đế are free on the portal and stay in the text.
The embankment and the Thủ Khoa Huân statue are the evening pin. The old station is a memory. No train runs.

interestGroups.title: Dining and F&B
interestGroups.summary: The town bowl is hủ tiếu, dry or with broth, any meal of the day.
body: Order hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho in town or at the pier court on 30 Tháng 4. The ward page says the bowl is breakfast, lunch, and supper. The workshop at ấp Hội Gia, phường Mỹ Phong, is where the sheets are made. It is not the address of the bowl.

Deep-fried elephant-ear fish, ginger honey tea, and coconut candy are on the Thới Sơn rural-tourism page. The 2019 court article also lists chè, sinh tố, and sâm bổ lượng. Bánh tét and bánh ít are village products. None of those has a licensed plate photograph, so they are not cards. Stall prices are check on arrival.

cards.title: Dining and F&B
cards.summary: Hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho, dry or with broth. The other named plates have no photograph here. A stall price is check on arrival.

interestGroups.title: Pagodas of the old town
interestGroups.summary: A morning at Vĩnh Tràng. Two other town temples are free on the portal and have no photograph.
body: Chùa Vĩnh Tràng is the photograph: the ceramic gate, the seated Buddha, and the hall. The portal prints a free gate, 06:00–23:00, and 120 minutes. No second tariff was opened. Confirm at the gate.

Chùa Bửu Lâm, at 162 Nguyễn Văn Giác on the portal, is also free, with 07:00–18:00 and the year 1742 on that page. A tour page prints 07:30–11:30 and 13:30–17:30, the year 1803, and two addresses. Two travel pages print 1802 and 162B. The year, the hour, and the address are not settled. Chùa Quan Đế, at 31 Đinh Bộ Lĩnh, is free and 07:00–18:00 on the portal. The yearly rites have no printed date. Neither building has a licensed photograph, so neither is a card.

cards.title: Vinh Trang Pagoda
cards.summary: The ceramic gate and the hall, on a 120-minute morning. The gate is free on the portal. Confirm it on arrival.

interestGroups.title: The garden on the Tien
interestGroups.summary: The evening walk uses the statue and the embankment. The station is a memory.
body: The Thủ Khoa Huân statue and vườn hoa Lạc Hồng sit at đường 30/4 and Trưng Trắc, old phường 1, now phường Mỹ Tho. Báo Xây dựng places the old station here. Walk it late afternoon. A ticket was not printed.

After dark, the 5 Jan 2019 article puts the pier food court open from 18:30 to 02:00. A travel page prints a night market at số 8 đường 30/4 from 18:00, busiest 19:00–22:00. A sourced hour when the embankment goes quiet was not found. The directory prints 288 Club at 288 Phạm Thanh, old Phường 5, as 20:00–02:00. That ward is now inside phường Đạo Thạnh. Those hours were not reconfirmed, and the club is not a bar guide.

cards.title: Thu Khoa Huan statue
cards.summary: The pin of the embankment, in the garden where the old station stood. The fee is check on arrival. No train runs.

faqs.q: How far is My Tho from Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: The provincial roads page says 70 km and about 1 hour on the Trung Lương expressway. A ticket page says 66 km and 1.7 hours toward Mỹ Tho, and 67 km and 1.7 hours toward Sài Gòn. Fares are check on arrival. There is no passenger train.
The road is 1 hour or 1.7 hours, so a same-day return reaches the town. The boat to Thới Sơn has to be the morning, not the hour you arrive. Sleep on đường 30 Tháng 4 if the embankment is the night.

The Đồng Tháp tourism portal prints Vĩnh Tràng, Bửu Lâm, Quan Đế, and Bảo tàng Tiền Giang as free. No second tariff was opened. Confirm at the gate. The cart is a separate ticket: 40,000 VND on route 1 and 30,000 VND on route 2.

faqs.q: Is My Tho still in Tien Giang?
faqs.a: The old city is five wards of Đồng Tháp: Mỹ Tho, Đạo Thạnh, Mỹ Phong, Thới Sơn, and Trung An. The working address on the government directory is 23 đường 30/4, phường Mỹ Tho, tỉnh Đồng Tháp.

season.label: Dry from December
season.note: The national place page starts the dry season in December and the rain in May. It prints an average of 28°C, humidity 79.2%, and rain of 1,500 mm. It does not name the month the rain ends, or a flood closure of the expressway. The hủ tiếu festival ran 27–31 Dec 2024 at Công viên Tết Mậu Thân. Báo Đồng Tháp also says it ran until the solar New Year of 2025. The provincial page calls that festival part of the 345th year of the town, 1679–2024. The national place page starts the settlement story in 1623. The next date is check on arrival.
